coordinateConvention: Full native 0-based top-left raster pixel centres. Homogeneous row-major imageToReferenceMatrix maps (x,y,1) to SMASH pixels after division by third coordinate. Native raster edges are -.5 and size-.5. Resize conversions include half-pixel centre offsets.
method: SIFT seed then discrete high-pass local-maximum centroid correspondence; RANSAC 1.5 px; unique SMASH point assignments; every third point held out from final homography fit; independently reject weak surrounding star-pattern matches using positive annular high-pass normalized correlation >0.3, excluding inner 4 px and extending to 18 px in SMASH working raster
limitations: SMASH AVM is the shared sky anchor, not an independent Gaia catalogue solution.
Correspondences represent matched point sources/star groups in display composites; no spectroscopic identity or photometric equivalence is claimed.
Held-out points were excluded from final homography least-squares fit but discovered using the common RANSAC seed.
Homography approximates unknown renderer/lens projection and distortion; outer source footprint beyond matched hull is extrapolation.
A quad-based overlay may approximate the fitted projective interior; inspect source near edges when fine tuning.
